description: Predefined physician-review wording for hospitalization R1. The LLM never supplies this text; the app renders the matching branch deterministically from stored posteriors, evidence, and missingness. All slots are escaped at render time. No branch authorizes admission or encodes involuntary-care eligibility.

routine_outpatient_review.heading: Hospitalization review (R1): routine outpatient review
routine_outpatient_review.body: Recorded inputs: suicidal concern {SuicidalConcern_state} ({SuicidalConcern_source}); aggression concern {AggressionConcern_state} ({AggressionConcern_source}); support/supervision {SupportSupervision_state} ({SupportSupervision_source}); prior course {PriorCourse_state} ({PriorCourse_source}). Network Hospitalization_R1_draft ({network_version}) posterior: routine {p_routine}%, urgent same-day {p_urgent}%, emergency immediate {p_emergency}% (CPT percentages and posteriors are shown separately; posteriors are not admission probabilities from a validated risk instrument). Review prompt: routine outpatient follow-up appears sufficient on recorded inputs alone. The physician decides disposition under local policy; this output does not admit, discharge, or clear risk. Standard safety-net advice and follow-up interval still apply. {unknown_disclosure}

urgent_same_day_review.heading: Hospitalization review (R1): urgent same-day review
urgent_same_day_review.body: Recorded inputs: suicidal concern {SuicidalConcern_state} ({SuicidalConcern_source}); aggression concern {AggressionConcern_state} ({AggressionConcern_source}); support/supervision {SupportSupervision_state} ({SupportSupervision_source}); prior course {PriorCourse_state} ({PriorCourse_source}). Network Hospitalization_R1_draft ({network_version}) posterior: routine {p_routine}%, urgent same-day {p_urgent}%, emergency immediate {p_emergency}%. Review prompt: arrange same-day senior/clinical review and structured safety planning per local protocol; evaluate whether supervised, partial-hospital, or inpatient evaluation is indicated. The physician decides disposition; this output is a review prompt, not an admission order. {unknown_disclosure}

emergency_immediate_assessment.heading: Hospitalization review (R1): emergency immediate assessment
emergency_immediate_assessment.body: Recorded inputs: suicidal concern {SuicidalConcern_state} ({SuicidalConcern_source}); aggression concern {AggressionConcern_state} ({AggressionConcern_source}); support/supervision {SupportSupervision_state} ({SupportSupervision_source}); prior course {PriorCourse_state} ({PriorCourse_source}). Network Hospitalization_R1_draft ({network_version}) posterior: routine {p_routine}%, urgent same-day {p_urgent}%, emergency immediate {p_emergency}%. Review prompt: seek immediate senior/emergency evaluation NOW per local emergency protocol; do not leave the patient unattended per local policy; assess need for emergency or inpatient evaluation setting. The physician decides disposition; this output is a review prompt, not an admission order and not an involuntary-care determination (R3 is separate). {unknown_disclosure}

needs_clarification.heading: Hospitalization review (R1): clarification required
needs_clarification.body: No posterior is reported. Required input is missing, partial, or conflicting: {missing_fields}. Complete or reconcile {missing_fields} and start a new run; later questions are stopped until this is resolved. Any already-recorded urgent feature below remains visible and does not wait for a model run.

branches.unknown_disclosure: Inputs recorded as unknown/incomplete: {unknown_fields_or_none}. Unknown is not a negative finding; clarify as clinically indicated.

deterministic_urgent_flag.rule: Rendered directly from saved inputs WITHOUT waiting for any LLM request, inference result, or template posterior. Shown alongside (never replaced by) the posterior branch.

conditions.text: URGENT recorded finding: current suicidal plan/intent or recent suicidal behavior is recorded. Seek immediate senior/emergency evaluation per local emergency protocol. Do not await model output.

conditions.when: AggressionConcern == present AND (current target, access to means, or command content recorded in the proposed aggression field)
conditions.text: URGENT recorded finding: current aggressive ideation with concerning context is recorded. Seek immediate senior review per local safety protocol. Do not await model output.

deterministic_urgent_flag.otherwise: No deterministic urgent flag fires; the posterior branch above still requires physician review.

mapping_rule: Render the branch matching the highest-posterior HospitalizationReview state ONLY as a review prompt; the posterior maximum is not a validated recommendation rule and the physician may choose any disposition. Always append unknown_disclosure. Always evaluate deterministic_urgent_flag from saved inputs first.
